title: Constraint-met derivation duplicated verbatim with DetailCard
description: The three-line derivation `const thresholdType = Object.keys(spec)[0]; const thresholdVal = spec[thresholdType] ?? 0; const met = isConstraintMet(thresholdType, 0, value, thresholdVal)` is identical in SummaryTab.tsx:61-63 and DetailCard.tsx:141-143. The repo already factors constraint logic into optimiserHelpers (`isConstraintMet`); the surrounding spec-key extraction belongs there too. Extracting a single helper (e.g. `constraintStatus(spec, value): boolean`) into optimiserHelpers.ts and calling it from both components removes the duplication and keeps the single-bound-key assumption (`Object.keys(spec)[0]`) in one place, consistent with CLAUDE.md's directive to share existing functionality.
evidence: Grep shows the same pattern at SummaryTab.tsx:61 (`const thresholdType = Object.keys(spec)[0]`), :62 (`const thresholdVal = spec[thresholdType] ?? 0`), :63 (`const met = isConstraintMet(...)`) and at DetailCard.tsx:141-143. Both feed `isConstraintMet` from optimiserHelpers.ts, which already centralises the comparison but not the spec-key extraction.
est_reduction: ~3 duplicated lines folded into one shared helper (~6 lines net across the two call sites)
behavior_preservation: Pure refactor: the extracted helper performs the exact same key lookup, default, and isConstraintMet call; identical boolean output for all inputs. No behavioural change.
